messages:
Nora Patel: quick kickoff for Helion Labs onboarding — 10-min thread to align stakeholders, success criteria, and the initial 10-day rollout. Helion wants Private deployment into their VPC, KMS integration, and a minimal SOC2 export. Pilot feature flag target: 2026-09-15. Success metrics: 95th pct latency <220ms at pilot load, uptime >=99.9%, and evaluation pass rate >=91% on 500-sample set.

Samir Das: I can own infra + smoke tests. Recommend using a q4 quantized model we validated on A10G. Need staging VPN creds and allowlist IPs. Ill submit a config PR with batching + KV cache and a small harness.

Olivia Park: Ill run enablement and the prompt tuning session. Propose two sessions: infra handoff (9/3 15:00 PDT) and prompts workshop (9/6 11:00 PDT).

Jared Kim: Helion availability afternoons PDT 9/2-9/6. We prefer logs retention 30d for pilot. Also need an export for SOC2 evidence.

Nora Patel: we can do 30d retention and produce the SOC2 export. Olivia, please send invites to Jared and their PM, Mei.

Samir Das: sample smoke test I'll run after creds:
curl -X POST https://private-api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"helion-llm-q4","input":"health"}'
Ill attach harness asserting 95th pct latency and an automated rollback trigger. PR by EOD 8/28.

cs-bot: onboarding-checklist updated: infra handoff scheduled; SOC2 export queued at /onboarding/helion/documents.

Jared Kim: clarifying acceptance gate: can brief bursts exceed 220ms if the 95th remains within target over a 30-min window? We need a clear gate for feature flag enablement.

Nora Patel: proposal: feature flag enablement requires 95th pct <=220ms AND error rate <=3% during a 30-min stress window at pilot load. If either fails, keep flag off and fallback to hosted model. Samir to add a 10% canary and rollback automation.

Samir Das: confirmed  Ill add dashboard panels for 95/99 pct and error rate, canary config, and rollback.

Olivia Park: action items: 1) Samir: infra PR + harness + rollback (due 8/28). 2) Nora: SOC2 export & docs (due 8/29). 3) Olivia: invites & agendas (sent). 4) Jared: staging creds & allowlist (ASAP). Reconvene after infra handoff to validate smoke test.

Jared Kim: creds and allowlist posted to secure vault; pinged your team. :thumbsup:

Nora Patel: thanks team  will circulate a short recap after infra handoff and tag owners: @Samir @Olivia @Jared. :white_check_mark:
